						url 	:'https://www.elmstba.com/wp-content/themes/elmstba/autocomplete.php',
						data 	: 's='+$('#s').val()+'',
						success : function(results) {
							$('#SearchResults').html(results);
						}
					});
				}
				if( $('#s').val() == '' ) {  $('#SearchResults').hide(); }
			},3000);

		     $('.allSections h3').click(function(){
		      $(this).next().slideToggle(450);
		     });
		      $('.allSections li').click(function(){
		      	if($(this).find('input').attr('checked') == 'checked') {
					$(this).find('input').removeAttr('checked');
					$(this).removeClass('checked');
		      	}else {
		      		$(this).find('input').attr('checked','checked');
					$(this).addClass('checked');

		      	}
		       
		      });
		         $('.allSections li input').click(function(){
		      	if($(this).attr('checked') == 'checked') {
					$(this).removeAttr('checked');
					$(this).parent().removeClass('checked');
		      	}else {
		      		$(this).attr('checked','checked');
		      		$(this).parent().addClass('checked');
		      	}
		       
		      });
		      setTimeout(function(){
		        $('.alertSuccess').fadeOut(500);
		      },3000);
		      
	                        $('.allMainTax li').each(function(){
                   var order = $(this).data('order');
                   $(this).css('order',order);
               });	         
	          		      
		} );
         
	</script>

<script defer="defer" type="text/javascript">
                $(function(){
                    var  offset   = 24,
                          loading  = false,
                          loader   = $('.blockContainer'),
                          noDate   = 0,
                          x        = 0;
        
                      var load_post = function(){
                        $.ajax({
                            url     : 'https://www.elmstba.com/wp-content/themes/elmstba/Interface/Ajax/scrollHome.php',
                            type    : 'POST',
                            data    : {
                            offset  : offset, 
                          },
                          success: function(msg) {
                                if(msg != ''){
                                  loader.append(msg);
                                }else {
                                   noDate = 1;
                                }
                                
                                loading = false;
                          }
                        });
                      };
                        $(window).on('scroll',function(){
                          if(!loading && noDate == 0 && $(this).scrollTop() >= $('.footer2').offset().top - 800 ) {
                            if(offset <= 5*24 ) {
                              loading = true;
                              load_post();
                              offset = offset  + 24;
                             
                            }
                            else if(offset == 6*24 && x==0) {
                               $('.blockContainer').append('<p>لقراءة المزيد يرجى تصفح الأقسام</p><br/>');
                               x = 1;
                            }
                          }
                        });
        
                });
         
            </script>
